brand.name: Elite Pro Academy
brand.tagline: More than play, we build the way

hero.title: More than play, we build the way
hero.body: A sports academy for children aged 5 to 14. Professional coaching across five disciplines — with every session recorded, and every parent kept in the loop.

programmes.title: Five disciplines, one standard
programmes.body: Children can train in more than one discipline at a time. Each group is banded by age and level, so your child is always with peers at their own stage.

football.name: Football
football.body: Technical skills, match play and tactical awareness, in age-banded squads.

swimming.name: Swimming
swimming.body: From water confidence through to stroke technique, taught in small groups.

gymnastics.name: Gymnastics
gymnastics.body: Strength, balance and body control — the foundation underneath every other sport.

martialArts.name: Martial arts
martialArts.body: Discipline, focus and self-control, taught with safety as the first principle.

nutrition.name: Nutrition & healthy weight
nutrition.body: Guided programmes that build healthy habits, run alongside training.

coaches.name: A coach who knows your child
coaches.body: Every squad is led by an assigned coach who follows your child's progress by name — not a rota of whoever is available.

records.name: Every session recorded
records.body: Attendance and assessments are logged for each session across four areas: physical, technical, tactical and behaviour.

reports.name: Reports you actually receive
reports.body: Progress reports reach you directly after sessions and at the end of each month, rather than sitting in a file you never see.

groups.name: Grouped by age and level
groups.body: Children train with peers at their own stage, and can move between groups as they develop.

contact.title: Enquire about a place
contact.body: Tell us your child's age and the sport they are interested in, and the academy office will get back to you.

portal.title: Already with us?
portal.body: Parents and coaches sign in to see schedules, attendance and progress reports.
portal.cta: Sign in to the parent portal
